import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.read_csv("/tmp/moutai_raw.csv", index_col=0, parse_dates=True)
df = df[df["Volume"] > 0].copy()  # 剔除停牌日
df.index = pd.to_datetime(df.index).tz_localize(None)

c = df["Close"]
first, last = c.iloc[0], c.iloc[-1]
chg = last / first - 1
print(f"区间: {df.index[0].date()} ~ {df.index[-1].date()}  共{len(df)}个交易日")
print(f"期初收盘 {first:.2f}  期末收盘 {last:.2f}  区间涨跌幅 {chg*100:.2f}%")

hi, lo = df["High"].max(), df["Low"].min()
print(f"区间最高 {hi:.2f} ({df['High'].idxmax().date()})  区间最低 {lo:.2f} ({df['Low'].idxmin().date()})")

# 最大回撤
cum = c.cummax()
dd = c / cum - 1
mdd = dd.min()
print(f"最大回撤 {mdd*100:.2f}% (谷底 {dd.idxmin().date()})")

# 均线
for w in [20, 60, 120]:
    df[f"MA{w}"] = c.rolling(w).mean()
print(f"当前 MA20={df['MA20'].iloc[-1]:.2f}  MA60={df['MA60'].iloc[-1]:.2f}  MA120={df['MA120'].iloc[-1]:.2f}  收盘 {last:.2f}")

# 波动率（日收益率标准差年化）
ret = c.pct_change().dropna()
vol_ann = ret.std() * np.sqrt(242)
print(f"日收益率标准差 {ret.std()*100:.2f}%  年化波动率 {vol_ann*100:.1f}%")

# 成交量
v = df["Volume"]
print(f"日均成交量 {v.mean()/1e4:.0f}万股  量能峰值 {v.max()/1e4:.0f}万股 ({v.idxmax().date()})")

# 阶段划分：分季度统计
dfq = pd.DataFrame({"close": c, "ret": ret})
q = dfq["close"].resample("QE").last()
qret = q.pct_change()
qret.iloc[0] = q.iloc[0] / first - 1
print("\n各季度收盘及涨跌幅:")
for t, val in q.items():
    print(f"  {t.date()}  收盘 {val:.2f}  季度涨跌 {qret[t]*100:+.2f}%")

# 52周高低点回撤
print(f"\n距区间最高点 {(last/hi-1)*100:.2f}%  距区间最低点 {(last/lo-1)*100:+.2f}%")

# 上涨/下跌天数
up = (ret > 0).sum(); down = (ret < 0).sum()
print(f"上涨 {up} 天 / 下跌 {down} 天 / 平盘 {(ret==0).sum()} 天")
df.to_csv("/tmp/moutai.csv")
"}
